beats.say: Sir Patrick Stewart died on 28 October 2026.
His legendary career spanned more than seven decades.
Born in 1940, he started on stage before becoming a global icon.
In 1987, he played Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation.
He then brought Professor Charles Xavier to the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
He reprised that role in 2026 in Avengers: Doomsday.
From theatre to superheroes, he mastered every era of entertainment.
That was Film Facts; subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
Who is your favourite character he played?

His career spanned more than seven decades.

He reprised the role of Professor Charles Xavier in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, including in 2026 in Avengers: Doomsday.
